description: In the diff viewer, Ctrl+F opens Monaco's find widget, typing in it works, and Escape closes the find widget, not the viewer. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a git repository with commits. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open the Diffs tool: click the button with aria-label exactly "Diffs" in the header's workspace toolbar (".chat-workspace-actions"). 3. The overlay ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 4. Wait until the first "select.diff-viewer-select" in the overlay (the file select) has more than 1 option (more than its placeholder). 5. Wait until the overlay's ".diff-viewer-editor" is visible and contains at least one ".monaco-editor" element. 6. The editor container must contain exactly 0 ".find-widget.visible" elements. 7. Without clicking or focusing anything, press "f" with the Control modifier. 8. ".diff-viewer-editor .find-widget.visible" should become visible. 9. Type "test.file" key by key (a real keystroke for each character, including the ".", which would otherwise trigger "next change" navigation). 10. The find widget's text box with accessible name "Find" (its textarea or input with aria-label "Find") should have a value containing "test.file". 11. The overlay should still be visible. 12. Press Escape. 13. There should be exactly 0 ".find-widget.visible" elements in the editor container. 14. The overlay should still be visible. 15. Press Escape again. 16. There should be exactly 0 ".diff-viewer-overlay" elements.

steps.expression: (() => { const sel = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-overlay select.diff-viewer-select'); return sel ? sel.options.length > 1 : false; })()

(() => { const inp = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-editor .find-widget textarea[aria-label="Find"], .diff-viewer-editor .find-widget input[aria-label="Find"]'); return inp ? inp.value : ''; })()
